build_sparse_multihead_attention: build a SparseMultiheadAttention module with configurable stride and expressivity for sparse self-attention
compute_checkpoint: compute the checkpoint index for a given word index using stride and expressivity parameters
compute_subset_summaries: compute the set of summary word indices across all stride windows up to a given length
compute_fixed_attention_subset: compute the fixed attention subset for a word index including its stride window and summary tokens
apply_sparse_mask: apply a sparse attention mask to attention weights to enforce the fixed factorized attention pattern
